runtime_needed: Read clear_box as a strict prefab-axis size in metres; never use the old x1.25 +0.02 allowance.
Keep original native-scale type allocation and per-item rotated bottom placement. Long cells also accept OneHandedWeapon so spears can route there.
No type-ignoring fallback into unrelated bow or shield cells.
These are asset/mirror checks, not in-game runtime integration.
clear_box_contract: Units 0-25 retain r4 strict frame-free clear boxes. For shield units 26-31, clear_box is a conservative native rotated-AABB allocation envelope for the demonstrated fixed pose; longitudinal ramp supports occupy empty AABB corners. Use the actual rotated mesh bottom at bottom_position_unity, scale 1, and the exported quaternion. Do not infer a universally empty volume or a supported pose for a different shield from this size check.
